$comment: Reviewed licence overrides for the shipped build (architecture §10.10.13). Read by .github/scripts/licenses.py (cargo) and web/scripts/licenses.ts (npm). Each entry was checked by hand against the files the package ships; a version bump fails the build until the entry is checked again.
